title: Once Upon A Farm shares slide further following nationwide product recall
summary: Investing.com -- Shares of Once Upon A Farm PBC (NYSE:OFRM) tumbled over 10% in premarket trade Monday, extending a 6% drop from Friday as mounting product safety concerns sparked aggressive selling. The slide accelerated as investors digested the company's decision to initiate a nationwide recall and reformulation of its Tractor Wheels soft-baked bars.

title: Once Upon a Farm to Host Business Update Conference Call on Monday, November 2, 2026 at 8:30 a.m. ET
summary: BERKELEY, Calif., October 31, 2026--Once Upon a Farm, PBC (NYSE: OFRM) (the "Company"), a leading high-growth company driving systemic improvement in childhood nutrition, today announced that John Foraker, CEO and Co-Founder, will host a business update conference call and webcast on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 8:30 a.m. ET to discuss the Company’s voluntary recall issued on October 30, 2026.

title: Once Upon a Farm Announces Recall and Reformulation of Tractor Wheels™ Due to Potential Choking Hazard
summary: BERKELEY, Calif., October 31, 2026--Once Upon a Farm is initiating a voluntary recall of its Tractor Wheels soft-baked bars due to potential choking hazard for toddlers ages 1.5 - 2.5. This decision was based on three consumer complaints. We acted out of an abundance of caution, in the best interest of our customers and our commitment to quality. We are working with the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA) to make sure affected products are removed and families have the information they need.

title: Once Upon a Farm to Report Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2026 Financial Results on Thursday, November 12, 2026
summary: BERKELEY, Calif., October 29, 2026--Once Upon a Farm, PBC (NYSE: OFRM) (the "Company"), a leading high-growth company driving systemic improvement in childhood nutrition, today announced it will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, on Thursday, November 12, 2026, after market close. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to discuss these results at 5:00 p.m. Eastern Time on the same day.
